use_case: Developers use Copilot to write and fix code while Actions automatically runs CI/CD pipelines to test and deploy that code on every commit.
Teams launch instant cloud-based development environments in Codespaces with Copilot embedded, enabling AI-assisted coding from any browser without local setup.
Teams create and track bugs or feature requests in Issues and visualize them on kanban boards and roadmaps in Projects to manage sprint and release planning.
Security scanning runs automatically inside Actions CI/CD pipelines to detect vulnerabilities and leaked secrets before code is merged into production.
Development teams extend Copilot's capabilities by connecting third-party tools and AI models from the Marketplace to customize their AI-assisted coding workflows.
